# EvidenSe

> EvidenSe is an independent advisory practice based in Lausanne, Switzerland, founded and run by Stéphane Schwander. It helps sport organisations, rights holders, brands and investors understand where commercial value is really being created, and what to grow, fund, back or stop.

## What EvidenSe does

The core thesis: visibility is not durable commercial value. Reach is easy to measure, easy to grow and easy to report. Monetisable demand is none of those things, so organisations optimise what they can see and hope the money follows. EvidenSe closes that gap by turning scattered commercial, audience and sponsorship signals into decisions that survive contact with a board or an investment committee.

The main engagement is the Decision Sprint: a fixed-scope, fixed-fee engagement of three to four weeks that gathers the organisation's commercial, audience, digital and sponsorship data, tests pricing, packaging, rights structure and audience quality, and delivers a board ready recommendation on what to grow, hold, reprice or stop. No retainer, no time-based billing, senior-led throughout.

Three domains of work: Sport Revenue Intelligence (commercial friction audits, asset repackaging, revenue sprints); Predictive Investment and Due Diligence (investment memos, target simulation, portfolio and partnership review); Decision systems for federations (fractional chief strategy support, AI-assisted decision workflows).

Method: modelling and AI process the evidence faster and more systematically than a traditional consulting team can, and are never used to produce the answer. Where predictive modelling genuinely adds value, EvidenSe works with selected partners including Largo.ai, an EPFL spin-off. Modelling processes the evidence. Senior judgement turns it into the decision.

## Who it is for

- Federations and leagues whose audience has grown faster than their revenue
- Investors, funds and acquirers about to commit capital to a sport property, team or sporttech target
- Brands and sponsors being asked to pay for exposure and needing an independent view of what that audience is worth
- Federations and institutional bodies facing a congress, budget cycle or rights renewal where the internal view will not converge

## About the founder

Stéphane Schwander spent nine years at UEFA as Digital Operations Manager, and eleven years at the FEI, the international federation for equestrian sport, as Head of Digital and then Head of Content and Platform Management. At the FEI he built and ran one of the strongest digital operations in Olympic sport, turning the federation into its own media platform and creating commercial inventory on owned channels rather than renting audience from broadcasters. He co-founded WNG in 2002 and has more than two decades of international experience across Olympic federations, European football and start-ups. He lectures at Toulouse Business School, has given guest lectures at the Institute of Sport Sciences of the University of Lausanne (UNIL) at the invitation of Professor Markus Lang, and advises start-ups, currently as adviser to PickEat.it (https://pickeat.it). LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/stephaneschwander/

The differentiator: consultants have the models but have never carried a decision through a congress. Federation insiders have the credibility but not the modelling. EvidenSe works in the overlap.
